body:
So...it was prescribed for generalized anxiety disorder.  It was also supposed to help with my problems of falling asleep.  I can honestly say that it has done both perfectly.  The only draw-back is the fact that drowsiness is a little more than mild the morning after taking a .5 mg pill.  In the most part it has almost completely taken care of my anxiety, insomnia, and my battles with bi-polar disorder.
